players.bio: Alfie George Alexander Kilgour (born 18 May 1998) is an English footballer who plays as a defender for EFL League Two club Bristol Rovers.
Arvin Appiah is an English professional footballer who plays as a left-back or winger for EFL League Two club Bristol Rovers.

Ben Purrington (born 20 May 1996) is an English professional footballer who plays as a left-back or versatile defender for EFL League Two club Bristol Rovers. Born in Exeter, he joined the Plymouth Argyle youth academy when he was nine and signed his first professional contract in May 2013.
Bobby Kamwa (born 18 March 2000) is a Cameroonian professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder or forward for EFL League Two club Bristol Rovers.
Bradley Young (born 5 May 2002) is a professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for EFL League Two club Bristol Rovers.

Ciarán Kelly (born 4 July 1998) is an Irish professional footballer who plays as a defender for EFL League Two club Bristol Rovers. He previously played for St Patrick's Athletic, the club where he started his professional career. He has also spent one season at Drogheda United as well as 3 seasons with Bohemians, where he was loaned out to NIFL Premiership side Ballymena United for 6 months.
Clinton Mola (born 15 March 2001) is an English professional footballer who plays as a defender or defensive midfielder for Bristol Rovers.

Ellis Harrison is a 32-year-old Welsh professional footballer who plays as a centre-forward for EFL League Two club Bristol Rovers. Harrison began his career at Bristol Rovers, making his senior debut at 17 in April 2011.
Fabrizio Cavegn (born 28 August 2002) is a Swiss professional footballer who plays as a forward for English club Bristol Rovers.

Jack Aitchison is a 26-year-old Scottish professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder or forward for EFL League Two club Bristol Rovers. Aitchison graduated from Celtic's school of excellence at St Ninian's Academy in Kirkintilloch in February 2016, at which time he joined Celtic full-time and became part of their Under 17 squad.

Jack Sparkes (born 29 September 2000) is an English footballer who plays as a left-back or left wing-back for EFL League Two club Bristol Rovers. Career Sparkes began his career with Exeter City and made his professional debut for the Grecians on 12 August 2017 in a 1–1 away draw at Swindon Town.

Joseph Richard Quigley (born 10 December 1996) is a professional footballer who plays as a forward for EFL League Two club Bristol Rovers. Club career AFC Bournemouth Quigley grew up in Lymington and attended Priestlands School. He joined AFC Bournemouth's academy in 2007 when he was eleven and by 2014, he was on his second year scholarship.

Keenan Gough (born 28 February 2006) is an English professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder and centre-back for EFL League Two club Bristol Rovers, on loan from EFL Championship club Charlton Athletic.

Kofi Balmer (born 19 September 2000) is a Northern Irish professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for EFL League Two club Bristol Rovers, on loan from Scottish Premiership club Motherwell. He has won caps for Northern Ireland up to under-21 level.
Macauley Anthony Southam-Hales (born 2 February 1996) is a Welsh professional footballer who plays as a right back for Bristol Rovers.

Reiss-Alexander Russell-Denny is a 20-year-old English professional footballer who plays as a central midfielder for EFL League Two club Bristol Rovers, on loan from Premier League side Tottenham Hotspur.

Richard Smallwood is a 35-year-old English professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder for Bristol Rovers in EFL League Two. Smallwood's natural position is the holding role in the centre of midfield; he has also been known to play centre back. He is a product of the Middlesbrough Academy and later became captain of the reserve team.
Riley-Jay Harbottle (born 26 September 2000) is an English professional footballer who plays as a defender for EFL League Two club Bristol Rovers.
Ryan James de Havilland (born 15 June 2001) is an English professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Bristol Rovers
Shaqai Tyreece Steven Forde (born 5 May 2004) is an English professional footballer who plays as a forward for EFL League One club Bristol Rovers.

Stephen James Evans (born 30 October 1962) is a Scottish professional football manager and former player who is the head coach of EFL League Two club Bristol Rovers. Born in Glasgow, Scotland, Evans played professional football for Bolton Wanderers, Clyde, Albion Rovers, Ayr United, Hamilton Academical and St Johnstone until a knee ligament injury ended his playing career at 24.

Thomas Lynn James (born 15 April 1996) is a Welsh professional footballer who plays as a defender for EFL League Two club Bristol Rovers. James has previously played for Cardiff City, Yeovil Town, Hibernian, Wigan Athletic and Salford City.

Tommy Leigh is an English professional footballer who plays as a versatile attacking midfielder for EFL League Two club Bristol Rovers, on a season-long loan from EFL League One side Bradford City. Career Tommy Leigh came through the youth ranks at Portsmouth before being released at the age of 16.
